# Tokens

The values in `tokens/*.json`, as the theme uses them. Values are changed in Figma and sent back by pull request (D-029). Every color is a custom property, `--gg-color-…` and `--gg-role-…`.

## Color roles and contrast

D-030. Text needs 4.5:1 on its surface; an action needs 3:1 against the surface around it.

| Text or action | On | Contrast | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text.default` | `surface.default` | 15.13:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.default` | `surface.tint` | 13.67:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.muted` | `surface.default` | 6.09:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.muted` | `surface.tint` | 5.50:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.link` | `surface.default` | 6.13:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.link` | `surface.tint` | 5.54:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.inverse` | `surface.inverse` | 10.92:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `action.on-default` | `action.default` | 6.13:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `action.on-bright` | `action.bright` | 11.58:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `action.bright` | `surface.inverse` | 8.36:1 | 3:1 |
| `action.default` | `surface.default` | 6.13:1 | 3:1 |
| `text.inverse` | `accent.green` | 6.13:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.inverse` | `accent.red` | 5.69:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.inverse` | `accent.gold` | 5.67:1 | 4.5:1 |
| `text.inverse` | `accent.purple` | 7.41:1 | 4.5:1 |

## Type

Alegreya Sans only (D-020). Sizes in px, size/line height (D-026, D-027).

| Role | Narrow, under 768px | Wide, 768px and up | Weight | Class |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <span class="gg-type-display">display</span> | 58px/56px | 119px/112px | 800 | `gg-type-display` |
| <span class="gg-type-h1">h1</span> | 37px/48px | 59px/68px | 800 | `gg-type-h1` |
| <span class="gg-type-lead">lead</span> | 37px/48px | 59px/68px | 400 | `gg-type-lead` |
| <span class="gg-type-h2">h2</span> | 30px/40px | 42px/48px | 700 | `gg-type-h2` |
| <span class="gg-type-h3">h3</span> | 24px/36px | 30px/40px | 700 | `gg-type-h3` |
| <span class="gg-type-h4">h4</span> | 19px/28px | 21px/32px | 700 | `gg-type-h4` |
| <span class="gg-type-body">body</span> | 19px/28px | 21px/32px | 400 | `gg-type-body` |
